content: Amba yoo Jesús-gwaluleged-idu, deun Augusto-César saila-dummadga Romaʼgi maigu, igar mesialid, bela-dulemar-bukwad ebisoye, igi mergudibeye.
Deun, Cirenio, Siria-yargi dummadga negdakmaiun, dule-ebisleged gebe imaklesad.
Bela ebislemalagala na e-neggwebur-e-neggweburse nadegusmalad.
José, Galilea-yargi, Nazaret-neggweburgi-gudii Judea-yarse, Rey-David-neggweburse, Belénʼye-neg-nugadse aligusmogad. Ade, José, David-e-wagwad, aga Belénʼse nonigusad.
Adi, a-neggweburgi e-ome-Maríaʼmala ebislegegar. Deun bato ebo nikuoye igar-maid. Degine, deun María bato gurgin-nika gudiid.
Belén-neggweburgi-gudimaladgine, Maríaʼga nagued-ibagan warmaknonikid.
Degine, gebe ega susugwa uklenonikid. Geb samorgi-obirmas, moli-omaed-urgi mimmi-mesisad, ar ade, emarga gabedneg sate gusad.
Baliwiturmar sognonikid, Jesús gwalulesye
Deun, a-ibagi Belén-neggwebur-dikarba, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad, e-sibad-wawaad mutik edarbebukwa gusmalad.
Agine, Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur-wargwen ukiar amarse nonikid, degine, Bab-Dummad-e-yeerdaklegedi bela emar-ebilis ibegwar ganonikid. Degidbali, sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi nue dobe itoarmalad.
Ar baliwiturdi amarga sogded: —Mer be dobgumar, ar bemarga gayaburba-nued, bela dulemar-weligwar-saed an sedanikid.
Rey-David-gwalulesad-neggweburgi, Belénʼgi, emi-ibagi bemarga Cristo gwalulesad. A-dule, Dule-Abonogedid, Dule-Bur-Dummadid, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled.
Magar be itomalagala, weyob-mai be dakdapmaloed: Mimmi samorgi-anwar moli-omaed-urgi mai be dakmaloed.
Degine, ukiar, baliwitur-abargi bukidar baliwiturmar-nibnegginmalad-baigan, Bab-Dummad-nug ogannonanai daklealid. Weyob sognanaid:
Degine, gannar baliwiturmar nibnegse nadmargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad na ga sokarmalad: “Anmar Belén-neggweburse nae. Neg-gusad anmar daknae. Ar Bab-Dummad anmar-owisosad.”
Degisoggu, gwae-gwae armarsunnad. José, Maríaʼbo sii, degi, mimmidi, moli-omaed-urgi mai daknonimalad.
Deyob daksamargu, sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi, baliwiturmar-ega-mimmigi-sunmaksadba, dule-baiganga sogsamalad.
Ar bela-dulemar sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad-ibmar-sogedi, geger itosmalad.
Ar Maríaʼdi, bela na e-gwagegi wargwen sedii gusad, agi binsadii gusad.
Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladi, ega-ibmar-soglesadba-ibmar-gusadi bela-daksamalad, degi, bela itosmalad. Degidbali, gannar armargu, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummodani, degi, ogannodani gusmalad.
Jesús Babse-goled-negse seleapid

Jesús ibabaabakgus (8) gwalulesadgi, Judíoʼmar-igar-maidba imakegala, e-abgan-uka-duku siksamalad. Jesúsʼye onugsasmalad. Ar igi baliwitur amba yoo María gurgin-nikued-idu ega sogsagusa, aba deyob onugsasmalad.
Moisés-Igar-Mesisadba na san-uruked-ibagan-imaked-bergusmargua, José, María-ebo, Bab-Dummadga Jesús-ukega Jerusalénʼse Jesús-senonimalad.
Ar igi Bab-Dummad-igargi narmakar mai:

content.text: “Ar gebesaila machigwa-inse nangi aidenonikile, Bab-Dummadga be ukoed,

content: Éxodo 13:2, 12
Degine, Bab-Dummad-gardagi narmakar-naibalid, Bab-Dummadga we-ibmar-ukoye:
Levítico 12:8

A-ibagangine, dule-wargwen, Simeónʼye-nugadi, Jerusalénʼgi gudigusad. A-dulede, dule-gwage-nuedid, Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadiidid, na Israel-bendakleged-edarbedimogad-duled. Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled a-duleba gudiguad.
Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledi Simeónʼga sogsad: “Be burgosurye, Bab-Dummadi, dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsadi be dakedsegoye.”
Geb Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-sogedba, Simeón Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse nonikid. José, María-ebo Moisés-Igar-Maidba-imakegala Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse mimmi-Jesús-senonimalad.
Agine, Simeón na e-swidagi mimmi-mesisgua, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummoded, weyob sogded:

content.text: ar ade, an-ibyagwar Bab-Dummad-dule-abonogoed-barmialid an daksad.

content: Isaías 42:6; 49:6
José, degi, María, Simeón-Jesúsʼgi-ibmar-sognaid geger itomalad.

Geb degi, Simeón, Joséʼga, degi, Maríaʼga sogsagu, Bab-Dummad begi nued binsaoye. A-sorbali, mimmi-e-nan-Maríaʼga sogded: —We-mimmi sulesad, Israel-yargi dulemar-dummagan-bukidar onogegar, degi, dulemar-binsarmalad dummaganga imakegar. We-mimmi Bab-Dummad-wilubga guega nonikid, oyogegar, Bab-Dummad sunna nabir dulemar-abonoye. Ar degi-inigwele, dulemar-bukidar mimmi-abingaosurmalad.
We-mimmiba bukidar-dulemar-gwage-binsananaid magar daklegoed. María, ar begardi be-san-burbagi es-suid-yolenaiyob be nunmak itogoed.

Agine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-bundor Anaʼye-nugadi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudimogad. A-omede, Fanuel-sisgwad, Aser-e-wagansik danikidid. Anaʼde bato nue-seredgusad. Unnila birgagugle (7) sui-nika gudigusad.

Emide, birga-dulabake-gakabake (84) nikad. A-mukwade Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigudaed, gwen nodisulid. Ibginedba, degi, mutikidba Bab-Dummadse gordii, degi, Bab-Dummadse-golega mas-gunsuli gudidaed.
Simeón deyob sunmakgwichidgi, Ana nonimogad. A-mukwa, Bab-Dummadga Jesúsʼgi dog-nuedye sogsagusad. Degi, Ana bela Jerusalénʼgi dulemar-Bab-Dummad-abonogoed-edarbedimaladga mimmigi sunmakdedaed.
Jesús gannar Nazaretʼse nonikid
José, María-ebo bela Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba ibmar-imaksad-sorba, gannar Galilea-yarse na e-neggwebur-Nazaretʼse-nonimalad.
Degine, mimmidi dungumai, gangumai, degine, nue-binsaed-ibed-gumai gusad. Ar Bab-Dummad a-machi-bipigi nue nabir binsadii gusad.
Jesús, Babse-goled-neggi gudigusad
Birga-irba Jesús-e-babgan, Oburgwilegoenad-Iba-daknaega Jerusalénʼse naddamalad.
Jesús birgambe-gakabo-nikadgi (12), e-babganba Jerusalénʼse nadmogad.
Ibamar-bergusgu, Jesús-babgan gannar Nazaretʼse armargu, machigwa-Jesúsʼdi Jerusalénʼgi besad. José, degi, e-nan-Maríaʼdi Jesús-besad wissurmalad.
E-babgandi, dulemar-danar-danimaladba Jesús daniye bimalanad. Ibagwengus-nanaedgine e-gwenadgan-abargi, degine, mag-dakmalad-abargi Jesús-amiarmalad, gwen amissurmalad.
Ar amissurmarsoggu, gannar Jerusalénʼse Jesús-aminonimalad.
Geb ibapaagine amidapmalad. Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad-nue-wisimalad-abargi-sii, amar-itosii, degi, amarse ibmar-egichii dakdapmalad.
Ar itobukmaladi bela geger dakmalad. Nue-ibmar-wisi Jesús-dakmalad. Degine, nue-imas Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar-abin-imake dakmarbalid.
E-babgan, dummagan-abargi-sii Jesús-dakarmargu, geger dakarmalad. E-nan Jesúsʼga sogded: —Machi, ¿ibiga we deyob be anmar-imaksa? Emide, an be-babmala surbinsa bebina miamakdimalad.
Geb degi, Jesús ega sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be an-amidimala? ¿Ar be wissurmarsi an-Bab-arbaedgi an arbaergebed?
Ar e-babgandi, Jesús-ega-ibmar-sogedi magar-itossurmalad.
Jesús e-babganba gannar arsunnad, Nazaretʼse nonisunnad. Jesús na e-babgan-sogedba gudigussunnad. Ar e-nandi bela we-ibmarmar na e-gwageginbi sedii, egi binsadii gusad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi ibmar-nue-wisidgi, e-dunguedgi, degine, Bab-Dummad-nue-nabir-egi-binsaedgi, degi, dulemar-nued-egi-binsaedgi, dungumai gusad.
